title: TAT-4036 feed status and last-updated time on order book and trades
description: Read-only testnet regression proof of retained price levels and Live receipt timestamps for order book and trades. First-frame timeout and disconnect behavior require controlled timer/provider tests because this adapter cannot suppress frames.

proofTargets.claim: The order book keeps rendering live price levels on the BTC order page (regression guard).
The order book panel shows a live feed status with a last-updated timestamp.
The trades panel shows its feed status with a last-updated timestamp.

setup-launch.intent: Start a fresh headless slot browser; the market data panels need no wallet connection

setup-open-order.intent: Open the market's order page on the slot dev server

gate-orderbook-tab.intent: Confirm the large-viewport panel shows the Order book tab selected

ac1-orderbook-levels.intent: Confirm the order book renders live bid levels

ac1-screenshot.label: AC1 order book renders price levels
ac1-screenshot.intent: Keep a picture of the order book levels

ac2-open-aggregation.intent: Open the order book price-aggregation menu (first menu trigger on the page)

ac2-pick-aggregation.intent: Select the 100 aggregation so testnet l2Book updates reach the panel

ac2-orderbook-feed-live.intent: Confirm the order book panel labels its WebSocket feed as Live

ac2-orderbook-feed-time.intent: Confirm the order book status shows the last-updated timestamp

ac2-screenshot.label: AC2 order book feed status with last-updated time
ac2-screenshot.intent: Keep a picture of the order book status badge

ac3-open-trades.intent: Switch the market data panel to Trades

ac3-trades-feed-status.intent: Confirm the trades panel labels its WebSocket feed as Live

ac3-trades-feed-time.intent: Confirm the trades status shows the last-updated timestamp

ac3-screenshot.label: AC3 trades feed status with last-updated time
ac3-screenshot.intent: Keep a picture of the trades status badge

account.description: Wallet fixture account for the slot browser (unused; no connection is made).
